classification: Provider command-response timeout with controller receipt-window mismatch; not a source rejection.
cause: The SDK may report loss after the controller reconciliation window has already closed, so no receipt read was attempted. Whether the original command completed remains unproven.
generic_change: Future commands record a timeout-aligned return/reconciliation window (computation+55seconds), clipped to the unchanged absolute stage deadline; one completed receipt/log may be verified, never a repeated scientific command.
